title_en: Reply of the Supreme People's Court on Whether the Court Should Accept a Lawsuit for Confirmation of Claims Filed by Tax Authorities for Late Payment Surcharges Arising from Tax Arrears of a Bankrupt Enterprise

articles.content_en:
June 26, 2012
Supreme People's Court
Reply on the Issue of Whether the People's Court Shall Accept the Action for Confirmation of Claims Filed by the Tax Authorities for Late Payment Surcharges Arising from Taxes Owed by Bankrupt Enterprises
Fa Shi [2012] No. 9
Higher People's Court of Qinghai Province:
Your court's Request for Instructions on the Issue of Whether the People's Court Shall Accept an Action for Confirmation of Claims Filed by Tax Authorities for Late Payment Surcharges (Qing Min Ta Zi [2011] No. 1) has been received. Upon study, the reply is as follows:
The People's Court shall accept according to law the action for confirmation of claims filed by the tax authorities for late payment surcharges arising from taxes owed by the bankrupt enterprise. In accordance with the relevant provisions of the Enterprise Bankruptcy Law and the Tax Collection and Administration Law, the late payment surcharges arising from taxes owed by the bankrupt enterprise before the acceptance of the bankruptcy case are ordinary bankruptcy claims. With respect to the late payment surcharges arising from taxes owed after the acceptance of the bankruptcy case, the People's Court shall handle the matter in accordance with the provisions of Article 61 of the Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on Certain Issues concerning the Trial of Enterprise Bankruptcy Cases.
This reply is hereby given.
